what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: XRP Ledger patches decade-old bug allowing attackers to create spendable XRP from nothing; no evidence of exploitation found.
titles: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing

items.line: CFTC proposes formal rule classifying event contracts as swaps, extending derivatives oversight to prediction markets while excluding casino-style gambling.
titles: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Concerning the Inclusion of Certain Event Contracts in the Definition of Swap

items.line: NY Attorney General settles Celsius founder Alex Mashinsky fraud case: permanent industry ban and up to $35 million in payments.
titles: New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement

items.line: Ledger hardware wallet reseller compromise tied to hardware implant; $86M+ in thefts confirmed across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other chains.
titles: Ledger Says Affected User’s Device Contained Hardware Implant

items.line: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announces plans to seize $1 billion in crypto linked to Iran this week.
titles: ‘We Know Where It Is’: Treasury Secretary Threatens To Freeze $1B of Iran’s Crypto

items.line: French legislative committee adopts stablecoin swap tax and crypto exit tax on wealthy holders, though 2027 budget revenue section later rejected.
titles: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
